Turn beautiful music into an instrument of destruction. Use sound to create powerful blasts which ignore armor.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Sense Soundwave
Active
[Active - Press] - Sonic Blast: Fires a sonic boom that deals 75 (150 with Mastery) damage ignoring armor at the cost of 50 MP - 1s Cooldown.
Active: [Active - Press] - Sound Wave: Deals 40 damage (70 with mastery) to everything in a 10x10 radius ignoring armor at the cost of 100 MP.
Active: [Active - Press] - Mind Requiem (Requires Mastery): Fires a sonic boom that does 150 Damage and 100 Spiritual Damage ignoring armor at the cost of 200 MP. Cooldown 3s.

Mend wounds with a touch or unleash devastating afflictions, capable of both salvation and suffering.

Active
[Active - Press] - Heal: Fully restores all HP at the cost of 80 MP (40 with Mastery) per HP. Fully restores all Spiritual HP at the cost of 60 MP per HP (Requires Mastery). If used while not looking at a target, applies to the player [Also remove Virus from the user], if used while looking at a target it heals them instead (require sneaking to heal others). [Physical Healing is done first, with MP cost - then to spiritual HP]
Active: [Active - Press] - Infection: Applies the Infection debuff to the looked at target [Cure Virus if the target already has the effect]. Costs 100 MP.
Active: [Active - Hold] - Plague [Requires Mastery]: Applies the Infection debuff to everything in a 15x15 radius. Costs 300 MP.
When toggled on, entities that produce noise within a 20 block Radius will be outlined in Green.

Unleash a powerful roar decimating all weak enemies in the way.

Active
Release a shriek attack that does 20 sound damage (30 with mastery) on non-spiritual beings in a 15-block range (20 with mastery), costs 500 MP. Cannot be activated if the user has Silence or doesn’t have max air/bubble.

Become one with the shadows and deal massive spiritual damage and become immune to lesser presence detection.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Thought Acceleration
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] Instakill: Makes the player's attack deal 500 (Configurable) Spiritual Damage (1000 Mastered, Configurable) at the cost of 3000 MP (Configurable), 10s Cooldown (Configurable) (5s Mastered, Configurable)
Must be in Instakill Mode for Effect to be active!!!
Active
[Active - Press] - Ultra Acceleration: Moves the player to where they're looking at high speed, effectively teleportation, 10 block radius, deal crit damage (+70 with Mastery) to anything on the way. Costs 100 AP.
Active: [Active - Hold] Espionage: Grants presence concealment 1(2 with mastery) which makes the player invisible and immune to being sensed by Magic Sense, Sense Heat Source, and Sense Soundwave. Becomes toggleable with mastery.

Radiate authority and charisma to force fear into the hearts of your enemies and to make them follow you instead, while empowering yourself and your allies.

Become Blessed upon obtaining Chosen One
Passive
[Passive - True] Hero’s Beacon (Unlocked with Mastery): All Skills, and Battlewill owned by a subordinate become the player's when they are killed (does not count if they are killed by the user).
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Hero’s Action: Hero of the Village V Effect
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] Hero’s Blessing: Grants a permanent Luck 5 effect. The player and their allies have a 100% critical hit rate and a 10% auto-dodge chance.
Active
[Active - Hold] Hero’s Haki: 25 MP per 20 ticks. When activated, all mobs within a 30x30 radius are affected, If their EP is =<75% of the user's used EP, it does nothing. Otherwise, give 1 Fear level for each 20% difference with the used EP
Active: [Active - Press] Hero’s Charisma: When activated, all passive and neutral mobs within a 20x20 radius will be treated as the player's allies and will assist them in combat for 120s [Negated by Spiritual Attack Nullification, reduced to 60s by Resistance]. Any mobs they or the player defeat will be resurrected as allies with half max health (Except Undead). When mastered this will only occur while Hero's Charisma is in-slot. Costs 200 MP.

Use your Hero Aura to inspire your allies and terrify your enemies.

Active
[Active - Hold] - 25 MP per 20 ticks. When activated, all mobs within a 30x30 radius are affected. With mastery, scroll while holding down the skill button to change the percentage of EP used for calculation. If their EP is =<75% of the user's used EP, it does nothing. Otherwise, give 1 Fear level for each 20% difference with the used EP

If activated and the player is standing on a block with a light level of 10 or lower, then grant them true invisibility, immunity to damage, and +0.1 Speed and +1 Step Height. This lasts as long as the button is held down and no attacks can be made nor can blocks be broken. While held down, the player will lose oxygen unless they don't need to breathe, ie Majin or Saint. Consumes 10 MP per 20 Ticks.
Shadow Step (Require Mastery): Instantly teleport behind the looked-at entity [Max distance: 20 blocks], costing 200 MP.
Shadow Storage (Require Mastery): While looking at a tamed subordinate, save the mob into a shadow item that doesn't break to environmental damage except Void damage. [Only works on mobs that don't need air - monsters or majin, doesn’t work on summoned spirits]. Right-click on the ground again to respawn the mob.

Become able to cast mastered magic instantly, in water or even under the effects of silence.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - For Mastered Magic, casting becomes instant. User will be able to cast magic even when air level is under max or silence effect is active. Enchantment particles are also reduced.

Summon an aura of sorrow that slows and weakens nearby enemies, filling them with despair. The skill also throws objects or air, amplifying the feeling of hopelessness around you.

Passive
[Passive, In Slot] Isha’s Tears - All players, even the wielder, and mobs, regardless of EP, are slowed by the player’s baneful aura. Slowness 4 for 10 seconds while near the player. The wielder only gets Slowness 2. Player gains Resistance 2 passively.
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Homing - All thrown objects home in on targets.
Passive: [Passive, True] Veil - When dropping below 25% HP, knock all entities within a 12 block radius backwards by a large amount and grant them Slowness 10 and Burden 4 for 30 seconds. Cooldown of 5 minutes.
Active
[Active, Press (100.0 MP)] Gust - Generate strong blasts of wind to throw and manipulate objects or deadly, sharpened wind. No cooldown.
Active: [Active, Hold] Turbulent Force - Pick up and control the movements of an entity you pick up. Maximum height of 5 blocks. (10 on mastery).
Active: [Active, Press (1000.0 MP.)] Grief - Cry out, knocking back entities within 8 blocks with moderate knock back and inflicting them with blindness and weakness 2 for 10 seconds. Cooldown of 10 seconds

Like the lizardmen, move through water and mud with no penalties while receiving a slight defense buff.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Grants the user 6 Armour Points and they suffer no movement penalties from water and mud blocks.

The crops, the wild, everything was there for you. You sow the seeds and wish only for a bountiful harvest. And in turn, the crops bless you.

Passive
[Passive, True] Hoe Mastery - All hoes deal increased damage, allowing even a wooden hoe to be useful.
Passive: [Passive, Toggled] Crop Mastery - Nearby crops have a 50% chance (per crop) every 5 seconds to grow by one stage. allowing you to vastly speed up the process of growing any crops. Consumes 20 MP every 5 seconds when toggled on.
Active
[Active, Press] Blessing - Bless the food stack you're holding. Based on the current time of day, blessing the food will grant various helpful buffs. You can give these foods to any entity as well, allowing you to give buffs to them.
For each item in the stack, consume 250 MP. On mastery, the cost increases to 500 MP per food item.
Blessed at Dawn: Gain Strengthen 3 for 3 minutes (Strengthen 5 for 5 minutes on mastery) from consuming it.
Blessed at Noon: Gain Resistance 1 for 3 minutes (Resistance 2 for 3 minutes on mastery) from consuming it.
Blessed at Night: Gain Speed 3 and 2.0 Step Height for 3 minutes (Speed 5 and 3.0 Step Height for 5 minutes on mastery) from consuming it.
This mode gains mastery differently! It DIVIDES the points you would gain by 10, based on how many items were in the item stack, rounded down to the nearest whole number.
For example, if I had a stack of 64 Steak, I would gain 6 mastery points instead of 1. However, if I were to just bless one, two, three, four, five, eight, or nine items, it would be 0 mastery points. You MUST minimally bless a stack of 10 to gain mastery.

Focus your eyes and become able to see things far away.

Active
[Active - Hold] - Spyglass, when held, scroll mouse to change zoom distance, Increases Analytical Appraisal distance when Mastered [Max: x50]. 0MP

Damn bro, no magicules?

Passive
[Passive, True] Beloved by Energy:
The user's magicule and aura regeneration rate is increased by 10x.
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Purification:
All of the user's attacks and abilities cost 50% less energy to utilize, be it Aura or Magicules.
On mastery, all abilities cost 66% less energy.
Active
[Active, Toggle] Emancipation:
On toggling this ability on, you will deal additional Holy Damage (1.75x) on top of whatever damage you were dealing.
Press again to toggle the ability off.
Costs 2000 Magicules to toggle on, and 300 to maintain every second. This cost is affected by (Purification).
Active: [Active, Press] Purity Edge:
The ability to channel pure holy spiritrons into your blade. For the next 3 seconds (5 on mastery) after activation, the user's next physical strike with a weapon is greatly empowered! It will instantly deal 25% of the target's health in damage, multiplied by 2 if the target is a Majin.
On mastery, this upgrades to 50%, which will one shot all majins without one-shot protection.
However, beware the drawback. Failure to channel your energy in time will cause the Holy Energy to recoil and damage the user instead, dealing 75% HP (50% HP on mastery) in damage to the user. Cooldown of 120 seconds, reducing to 60 on mastery.
Costs 10,000 Magicules to activate, which is affected by (Purification).

Increase your size and boost your physical stats.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Engorge: When toggled on, increases the player's size by 1.5 times and grants various passive buffs (0.4 Knockback Resist, Knockback 1, 10 Bonus Damage, 2X Speed, 10 Armour, +1 Attack Range Boost). Makes the players hunger permanently fully saturated.
Active
[Active - Press] Amplify: When activated (need Engorge toggled on), double all the buffs from Engorge for 2 minutes at the cost of 300 MP. If activated again while currently buffed, causes the user to dash forward in the direction they're looking and deals Current Weapon Damage + 50 (100 with Mastery) Damage to all mobs that they touch during the dash at the cost of 150 MP [Sneaking will half the dash distance] - Toggling off Engorge will stop this mode.
